title: Expanded 24-Layer Stack with Quarter-Wave Seeded Initialization
scientific_hypothesis: Adding two additional layer pairs (24 total layers vs. prior 22) provides sufficient degrees of freedom to sharpen the visible-band reflectance edge while maintaining NIR transmittance, potentially exceeding the 0.9251 score ceiling observed in iteration_07.
design_principle: Quarter-wave baseline initialization at 550nm center wavelength with expanded thickness bounds (±25nm) allows the optimizer to discover non-quarter-wave solutions that better separate the 450-650nm reflectance band from the 700-1000nm transmittance band.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 stack starting with TiO2 on fused silica substrate, terminating with SiO2 outer layer
manufacturing_considerations: SiO2 termination layer protects underlying high-index layers
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
Layer count vs. reflectance bandwidth relationship
expected_advantages: Additional layer pairs increase stopband width
More thickness variables enable finer spectral shaping
Approaches manufacturing limit to extract maximum performance
known_risks: Increased layer count may reduce robustness to thickness errors
Optimization may converge to local minima with 48 thickness variables
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer planar dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45° incidence using TiO2 (high index) and SiO2 (low index) in alternating sequence starting with TiO2. Initialize all layer thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness for 550nm center wavelength (approximately 57nm TiO2, 96nm SiO2). Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with bounds of ±25nm around initial values. Maximize a composite objective: mean reflectance over 450-650nm band plus mean transmittance over 700-1000nm band, with equal weighting. Incident medium is air. Evaluate both s and p polarization states and report unpolarized average performance. Total layer count is exactly 24 finite layers. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Prior 22-layer variants (12 fingerprints) exhausted; expanding to 24 layers tests whether additional degrees of freedom can exceed the 0.9251 score ceiling from iteration_07.
